ios.desc:
Universal Palette Converter (UPC) helps you move color palettes between formats without rebuilding them manually.

Import palettes from design tools, files, or raw text/code, then export them into formats that work elsewhere.

It’s useful if you’ve ever needed to reuse colors across apps or environments.

Examples:

- For designers: export a palette from Affinity and import it into Procreate
- For developers: copy colors from one codebase and reuse them in another
- From design to code: take colors from a UI file and export them as CSS or JSON
- From anywhere: extract colors from text, a website, or a document and turn them into a usable palette

What you can do:

- Import palettes from common design formats (ASE, ACO, GPL, Procreate, Affinity, Sketch, Corel, and more)
- Extract colors from text or code (Hex, RGB, HSL, CSS, JSON, JavaScript, Swift, Kotlin, XML, Dart, etc.)
- View and inspect colors in multiple formats and color spaces
- Convert palettes between formats
- Export to files for design tools (ASE, ACO, GPL, Procreate, Sketch, and others)
- Export as code (CSS, JSON, JavaScript, Swift, Kotlin, Dart, XML, SVG, etc.)
- Generate palette images (PNG, JPEG) for sharing

Other details:

- Works fully offline
- No account required

--- Import from:

Files:

- Adobe Color Book (ACB) | .acb
- Adobe Color Book Legacy (ACBL) | .acbl
- Adobe Color Swatch (ACO) | .aco
- Adobe Color Table (ACT) | .act
- Adobe Swatch Exchange (ASE) | .ase
- Affinity Designer Palette | .afpalette
- ArtRage 6 Color Palette (COL) | .col
- Color Exchange Format (CXF) | .cxf
- ColorSchemer Studio | .cs
- CorelDraw 4 Palette | .pal
- GIMP Palette | .gpl | Gimp, Inkscape, Krita, KolourPaint, Scribus, CinePaint, MyPaint
- Homesite Palette | .hpl | Allaire Homesite, Macromedia ColdFusion
- KOffice Palette | .colors | Calligra Suite, KDE Applications
- Paint.NET Palette | .txt
- Procreate v1 Swatches | .swatches
- Procreate v5 Swatches | .swatches
- Jasc / Corel Paint Shop Pro Palette | .pal, .psppalette
- Rebelle | .txt, .colors
- Resource Interchange File Format (RIFF) | .pal
- Scribus Swatch | .xml
- sK1 Palette | .skp | sK1
- Skencil Palette | .spl | Skencil, sK1
- Sketch Palette | .sketchpalette
- StarOffice Colors | .soc | StarOffice, OpenOffice, LibreOffice

Any text containing the following formats:

- Hexadecimal color codes
- CSS/SCSS/LESS color values and variables
- JSON
- JavaScript/TypeScript constants
- XML/Java/Kotlin
- iOS Swift/Objective-C UIColor
- macOS Swift/Objecti

quotes.text:
Hi HN! I built a simple tool to solve a common headache for designers and developers - converting color palettes between different formats. It handles pretty much every major format out there (Adobe, Sketch, Procreate, Paint.NET, etc.) and can export to various programming languages like Swift, Kotlin, and Dart.

No internet connection needed, no subscriptions, just a simple one-time purchase ($2.99).

Would love to hear your thoughts and feedback! Full feature list and supported formats in the link.
